tools.name: search_medications
tools.description: Typeahead search by what a person calls a medication: brand, ingredient or everyday name. Returns brand and ingredient groups in the order a person would pick, not packages.

tools.name: get_form_options
tools.description: The forms (tablet, liquid, patch…) and strengths a medication comes in, with labels for people and values to send back. Use the id from a search hit.

tools.name: get_drug
tools.description: The full record for a Pillwise drug id: names, ingredients, form, strength, packages and recalls.

tools.name: get_packages
tools.description: The package NDCs that belong to a Pillwise drug id.

tools.name: lookup_ndc
tools.description: The package and drug for an NDC: 11 digits, 10 with hyphens (4-4-2, 5-3-2 or 5-4-1), or a product NDC. A bare 10-digit code is matched only as listed; no padding is guessed.

tools.name: lookup_rxcui
tools.description: The clinical drug for an RxCUI.

tools.name: list_recalls
tools.description: Drug recalls, filtered by at least one of ndc, drug_id or since.

tools.name: list_shortages
tools.description: Drug shortages, filtered by at least one of ndc or drug_id.

tools.name: catalog_freshness
tools.description: How current the catalog is: the snapshot served and when it was built.
